text: あなたって　いつも　わたしが　およいで　いるときに　くるんだもん

structure.jp: わたしが　およいで　いるときに

patterns.name: 〜んだもん
patterns.explanation: んだもん at the end gives a reason in a childish or complaining tone, like 'because, you know'. くるんだもん = 'because you come'.

patterns.name: 〜とき
patterns.span: およいで　いるときに
patterns.explanation: とき after a verb means 'at the time when' that is happening. およいで　いるときに = 'when I am swimming'.

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a word is a casual way to bring it up as the thing you are talking about. あなたって = 'as for you'.
